title: Menu structure audit (blocks → sections → items)
summary: Legacy-manual platform: confirm the ADM hierarchy before automated scans; then run the full canonical audit against the exported menu.

steps.title: Confirm ADM hierarchy matches the running POS build
steps.instructions: ADM: menu = ordered blocks; blocks contain sections; sections hold items with attached modifiers. Export the menu (or use the latest export) and confirm revision/date matches the terminals — Aloha config drifts across versions; re-verify against the client’s manual revision.

Findings review with the client
